headline_read: 267b-v0 made the intended architectural anti-collapse change, but the plain ELBO model still collapsed completely. KL remained at zero and the latent path was still ignored. Decoder-bypass reduction alone is not enough to make the latent token path necessary.
mechanism_conclusion: Reducing the decoder's direct history bypass increased sample width slightly, but it did not turn on latent usage. KL still stayed at zero.
Structural behavior changed in a mixed way: rank improved, mean correlation fell below the lower gate, and cointegration collapsed.
So the plain probabilistic latent-token family remains alive only in a very weak sense. The key result is that architectural bypass reduction alone is insufficient to prevent collapse.
At this point, staying in the same plain-ELBO latent family without heuristics is no longer the most principled use of time.
next_question: What is the cleanest direct conditional scenario generator that models the future path itself, instead of trying to route stochasticity through a collapsed latent-variable bottleneck?
